content: Melvin-Koushki says the focus of the Mafāḥiṣ, as specified in its section 2.6, is the form of the letters as revealed to the prophets and the elite among the saints, admitting no admixture with conventional meanings external to the letters. This is contrasted with the form that does admit such admixture, the purview of Ghazālī and Ibn Sīnā and of Ibn Turka's own grandfather Ṣadr al-Dīn Turka and elder brother Ṣadr al-Dīn.
